function_v0.doc:
Pure: the exact text an owner signs (`personal_sign`) for `payload` authorizing the
calls named by `fn_names`, so the page and the contract have one source of truth.
`fn_names` must be the function names of the contexts the host will hand
`__check_auth`, in that exact order: for one root invocation with no sub-invocation,
that one name. A different list is a different digest, so the signature recovers to
a stranger. More than `MAX_CONTEXTS` names refuses with `ContextRefused`.
function_v0.name: auth_text

udt_union_v0.doc: Instance storage: five keys, written together by the constructor, one TTL to maintain.
udt_union_v0.name: DataKey

void_v0.doc: `Vec<BytesN<20>>`: the owners' Ethereum addresses, in signer-index order.
void_v0.name: Signers

void_v0.doc: `u32`: distinct valid signers an authorization needs.
void_v0.name: Threshold

void_v0.doc: `Address`: the hstXDC token whose role-gated calls this account authorizes.
void_v0.name: Token

void_v0.doc: `String`: the short network name written into every signed text.
void_v0.name: Network

void_v0.doc: `Vec<Symbol>`: the token functions this instance authorizes, as constructed, in the\norder given. There is no setter: a different list is a different instance.
void_v0.name: Allowed

function_v0.doc: The owners themselves append `address` as the last signer; the invariant is\nre-checked (at most `MAX_SIGNERS`, no repeat).
function_v0.name: add_signer

function_v0.doc:
The host's question when any contract calls `require_auth()` on this address. The
contexts are checked first, before any recovery is paid for: at most `MAX_CONTEXTS`,
each a call on the token to one of the names in `Allowed`, or on this contract to
one of its own admin functions. Their function names, in order, become the second
line of the signed text, which is rebuilt from the payload and hashed as
`personal_sign` does; each signature is recovered and compared with the signer it
names, and the indices must strictly ascend, so no signer counts twice. The host
already refuses a high `s`; the nonce and the expiration are the host's too.
function_v0.name: __check_auth

function_v0.doc: The owners themselves drop the signer at `index`; the signers after it move down one\nindex. The invariant is re-checked, so the threshold must still be reachable.
function_v0.name: remove_signer

function_v0.doc: The owners themselves (a threshold of them, through `__check_auth`) replace the\nsigner at `index` with `new_address`; the invariant is re-checked.
function_v0.name: rotate_signer

function_v0.doc: The owners themselves set the threshold; `MIN_THRESHOLD..=signers.len()`.
function_v0.name: set_threshold

function_v0.doc:
Runs inside the deploy transaction, so there is no window in which a stranger can
initialize a freshly deployed account. Sets the five keys at once; refuses a
threshold below `MIN_THRESHOLD` or above the signer count, more than `MAX_SIGNERS`
signers, a repeated signer, an empty or over-long network name, and an `allowed`
list that is empty, longer than `MAX_ALLOWED`, repeats a name, or holds a name that
is not a function name (a `Symbol` of at most `MAX_FN_NAME_LEN` characters). The
list is the token functions this instance authorizes, in the order given, and is
never changed after: there is no setter.
function_v0.name: __constructor

udt_struct_v0.doc:
One signed statement about the XDC reserve, submitted by the attestor role.
Amounts are XDC in 7-decimal fixed point (the token's own decimals).

The attestation carries the exchange rate explicitly instead of the contract deriving it
as reserve \xc3\xb7 claims: a deposit into the reserve must create mint headroom (amount up, rate
unchanged) while rewards move the rate (rate up, headroom unchanged). The contract
enforces solvency (`claims * rate <= amount`) and the per-attestation rate cap, so the
attestor's freedom is bounded on both axes.
udt_struct_v0.name: Attestation

fields.doc: The Stellar account that submitted it (must hold the ATTESTOR role).
fields.name: attestor

fields.doc: XDC per hstXDC, `RATE_SCALAR` fixed point. Must satisfy solvency and the change cap.
fields.name: rate

fields.doc: XDC-chain address of the reserve (custody address or masternode).
fields.name: reserve_address

fields.doc: Unix seconds of the reading. Strictly increasing; never in the future.
fields.name: timestamp

fields.doc: XDC block height the reading was taken at. Strictly increasing.
fields.name: xdc_block

udt_struct_v0.name: PriceStatus

udt_union_v0.doc: Where one borrow facility stands. Repaid, Claimed and Cancelled are terminal.

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Limits the token enforces on attestations. Two of them bound a compromised attestor
key in time, not just per step: `min_interval_secs` is measured on the ledger clock
(attestor-supplied timestamps cannot consume it) and `max_daily_rate_change_bps` caps
the total move inside any rolling `RATE_BUDGET_WINDOW_SECS` window against the rate the
window opened with.
udt_struct_v0.name: AttestationConfig

fields.doc: Age in seconds after which an attestation is stale: the rate freezes and minting stops.
fields.name: max_age_secs

fields.doc: Maximum cumulative rate change inside one `RATE_BUDGET_WINDOW_SECS` window, in basis\npoints of the rate at the window's start.
fields.name: max_daily_rate_change_bps

fields.doc: Maximum exchange-rate change per attestation, in basis points of the previous rate.
fields.name: max_rate_change_bps

fields.doc: Minimum ledger seconds between two accepted attestations. Must not exceed `max_age_secs`.
fields.name: min_interval_secs
